newsitem.title: USA: IDEX says Q4 in line with expectations.
newsitem.headline: IDEX says Q4 in line with expectations.

text.p: IDEX Corp said on Tuesday that its earnings for the fourth quarter were in line with analysts' expectations.

Earlier, IDEX reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.45 a share, up from $0.39 a year ago, both adjusted for a previously announced three-for-two common stock split. Full-year 1996 earnings adjusted for the split were $1.69 a share, up from $1.53.
On a pre-split basis, IDEX said it earned $0.68 for the quarter and $2.53 for the year. These results, the company said, were "very much in line with analysts' expectations."
The company did not specify analysts' projections for the quarter. According to First Call, the consensus for the quarter on a pre-split basis was $0.68 a share, up from $0.58 a year ago.
